value.body: Food Safety Officers enforce the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. They inspect food businesses, draw samples for testing, check licences and hygiene, and act on violations. The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) recruits Central Food Safety Officers; each state's food safety department recruits its own Food Safety Officers.

items.label: Who recruits
items.value: FSSAI (central) and state food safety departments

items.label: Degrees accepted (as notified)
items.value: Food, Dairy, Oil Tech; Biotech; Agri or Vet Science; Biochemistry; Microbiology
items.note: Also a master's in Chemistry or a medical degree; check each notification

items.label: CFSO pay level (FSSAI)
items.note: Central Food Safety Officer; state FSO pay is set by each state

items.label: CFSO vacancies in that FSSAI drive
items.note: 37 notified; revised to 35 in Oct 2022, subject to a court matter
items.source: FSSAI notice DR-04/2021 and revised vacancy notice

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hold a degree in one of the subjects listed in the notification. For central posts, apply when FSSAI advertises direct recruitment; selection has been through a computer-based test followed by an interview. State posts are filled through the state PSC or a state selection board, with the state's own exam, age and domicile rules.

value.title: At a glance
items: FSSAI does not recruit every year; state recruitment is also irregular.
The work is field-based: inspections, sampling and legal follow-up, often across a district.
Age limits, fees and the exact list of degrees are set in each notification.
